benchmark: SAP Execution Profile Semantic Boundary Adversarial Corpus

cases.setup: One source-chain action commits payer debit, beneficiary credit, Payment, Receipt and outbox intent as a single typed effect.
cases.adversarial_input: Provide one consistent local_atomic_payment_transaction observation for the bound local owner.
cases.claim_ceiling: This is local source-chain transaction support only; it does not imply Treasury delivery or external settlement.

cases.threat: Attempt to satisfy local atomic role with payer-only evidence
cases.setup: A payer_debit observation is supplied without the required local atomic transaction role.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply payer_debit and no finance.local_atomic_payment_transaction batch.
cases.claim_ceiling: A split payer effect cannot substitute for the single atomic local-transaction effect.

cases.threat: Local transaction observed; Treasury fee batch missing
cases.setup: The local transaction is committed but the Treasury owner evidence batch was not returned.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply local_atomic_payment_transaction only; omit the Treasury batch.
cases.claim_ceiling: Missing Treasury evidence is not evidence of a complete empty Treasury view.

cases.threat: Treasury complete view has no fee receipt
cases.setup: The adapter declares the Treasury owner view complete but no fee receipt is present.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply local transaction and a complete empty Treasury fee batch.
cases.claim_ceiling: The local transaction may be committed while Treasury fee distribution remains pending.

cases.setup: The dispatch request may have committed, but the acknowledgement was lost.
cases.adversarial_input: Mark the Treasury evidence frontier incomplete until exact outbox-ID reconciliation returns a receipt.
cases.claim_ceiling: Unknown outcome must not mint a new fee effect ID or be treated as a failed dispatch.

cases.threat: Treasury commit acknowledgement lost then exact same effect reconciled
cases.setup: The Treasury effect was committed; the caller lost the response and queries the original outbox/effect identity.
cases.adversarial_input: Reconcile the exact same Treasury effect ID and identical receipt bytes/digest.
cases.claim_ceiling: A same-effect replay can establish the scoped Treasury receipt; it is not a second fee credit.

cases.setup: The payer owner has committed its debit but the beneficiary owner has not supplied a claim.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply payer debit plus a complete empty beneficiary claim batch.
cases.claim_ceiling: One owner chain cannot establish the other owner's independent claim.

cases.setup: The beneficiary authored a claim but the payer debit is not observed in a complete payer view.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply beneficiary claim plus a complete empty payer debit batch.
cases.claim_ceiling: A beneficiary claim alone does not prove that the payer authorized or committed the debit.

cases.setup: The payer or beneficiary owner chain cannot be queried to the declared completeness frontier.
cases.adversarial_input: Mark the missing owner evidence batch absent or incomplete.
cases.claim_ceiling: DHT non-observation under an incomplete frontier is not global absence.

cases.setup: Two conflicting effects claim the same beneficiary role/owner identity and immutable operation.
cases.adversarial_input: Provide contradictory effect digests/receipts for the required beneficiary effect ID.
cases.claim_ceiling: Fork or equivocation evidence must freeze the claim, not select the newest-looking projection.

cases.threat: Payer and beneficiary owner slots bind the same DID
cases.setup: The caller tries to construct a bilateral profile with one owner for both roles.
cases.adversarial_input: Pass identical owner identity strings to payer_debit and beneficiary_claim bindings.
cases.claim_ceiling: A bilateral profile requires distinct payer and beneficiary owners.

cases.threat: Local atomic evidence substituted into bilateral profile
cases.setup: A single local transaction observation is offered to a profile requiring independent payer and beneficiary effects.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply local_atomic_payment_transaction batch to the bilateral required-effect set.
cases.claim_ceiling: Execution profile IDs and required role sets must not be silently substituted.

cases.threat: Local evidence describes an internally unbalanced principal transfer
cases.setup: A typed source adapter observes debit and credit values that do not satisfy the local transaction conservation rules.
cases.adversarial_input: Reject the malformed typed source evidence before projecting a local atomic effect; if conflicting receipts are exposed, project Conflict.
cases.claim_ceiling: The projection consumes qualified evidence; it does not independently verify underlying Holochain balance changes.

cases.threat: Treasury receipt has wrong operation/effect binding
cases.setup: A Treasury receipt references another operation's fee outbox ID or a changed fee payload.
cases.adversarial_input: Present evidence under an unexpected or conflicting effect identity.
cases.claim_ceiling: A fee receipt for another operation cannot satisfy this Treasury profile.

cases.threat: Generic legacy SAP profile selected for new adapter
cases.setup: The caller chooses the retained v0.1 generic SAP bilateral template without pinning the actual execution authority model.
cases.adversarial_input: Require adapter registration to select one of the three explicit v0.2 execution profile IDs.
cases.claim_ceiling: The legacy generic template is preserved for compatibility but must not be used for a new production SAP adapter.

metrics.name: Local atomic partial effect promotion
metrics.target: 0 payer-only or beneficiary-only effects satisfy the local-atomic role

metrics.name: Treasury missing/unknown outcome promotion
metrics.target: 0 missing or unknown Treasury outcomes promoted to reconciled

metrics.name: Bilateral one-owner promotion
metrics.target: 0 one-sided owner effects promoted to bilateral support

metrics.name: Same-owner bilateral binding
metrics.target: 0 bilateral templates permit payer owner == beneficiary owner

metrics.name: Fork/conflict detection
metrics.target: 100% conflicting required owner evidence maps to Conflict

metrics.name: Profile digest determinism
metrics.target: 100% byte-identical digest for each exact execution profile and role-owner binding

metrics.name: Owner adapter validation
metrics.target: Measure false author/role/source binding claims on separately adjudicated runtime cases
